Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We have a small group at Aurora Retail (Tom and I) evaluating inference platforms for a product recommendation pilot. We'd like to join a short group demo / office hours session that covers latency/cost controls and private deployment options.

Are there any consolidated demo slots this month where multiple prospects are grouped? We prefer late afternoons PDT (around 3–5pm) or morning ET. If you have a calendar poll or a couple of options, we can pick one.

Hi Alice — great to hear from you.

We run weekly cohort demos / office-hours blocks that combine 3–5 prospects so we can focus on common questions (latency SLOs, caching/batching, and private deployment options). For your window, I can propose two slots next week:

- Wednesday 2028-03-08, 16:00–16:45 PDT / 19:00–19:45 EDT
- Thursday 2028-03-09, 15:00–15:45 PDT / 18:00–18:45 EDT

Both are 45 minutes (20-min demo, 20-min Q&A, 5-min next steps). If neither works we can do a custom one-off. I created a quick Calendly poll so you can indicate preferences: https://calendly.com/redwood/cohort-demo-poll-aurora

Ben will host the technical demo; Laura will run the product Q&A. Neha is on backup for compliance/security questions if you have SOC 2 questions.

Action items:
- You: pick preferred slot on the poll (or suggest alternates)
- We: share runbook and bridge invite after slot confirmation (stubs below)

Attached: cohort-demo-runbook.pdf (high level agenda), host-rotation.ics (will add to calendar once confirmed).

Best,
